content: Skill `frp-port-migration` updated. The frp-port-migration skill file was updated to add a dedicated troubleshooting resource for resolving self-hosted service access failures caused by backend port migrations, port conflicts between frps and local reverse proxies, and FRP/tproxy misconfigurations, including use case triggers, a layered 3-layer diagnostic mental model, and repeatable reachability and application health audit checklists. Impact: medium
